title: Categorical equivalences of labelled coproducts of quasicategories
statement:
Use small simplicial sets and quasicategories as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and categorical equivalences as in [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], in its fixed universe. Let $I$ be a small set, let $X_i,Y_i$ be small quasicategories for each $i\in I$, and let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be simplicial maps. Form the degreewise disjoint unions $X=\coprod_{i\in I}X_i$ and $Y=\coprod_{i\in I}Y_i$, with all simplicial operators preserving the index $i$. They are quasicategories, and the label-preserving map
$$f=\coprod_{i\in I}f_i:X\longrightarrow Y$$
is a categorical equivalence if and only if every $f_i$ is a categorical equivalence. Empty $I$ and empty individual quasicategories are permitted; no connectedness of $X_i$ or $Y_i$ is assumed.
